description: This file defines the ResponseInterface, an interface for representing server-side HTTP responses, including methods to get and set status codes and reason phrases, following PSR-7 standards.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response status code as an integer.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified status code and optional reason phrase, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code, or an empty string if none.
